newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil - diesel and Russian prems edge higher.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil - diesel and Russian prems edge higher.

text.p: NWE gas oil was a touch easier on broadly steady premiums and narrowly weaker futures. Russian premiums were 50 cents or so stronger and prompt diesel was up $1-2 a tonne.
May IPE gas oil closed 75 cents lower at $164.00 a tonne, having spent most of the day within a tight range.
Traders said Russian premiums for 25,000 tonne cargoes were marginally stronger by 50 cents or so with buying interest heard at May IPE +$2 cif NWE. Sellers were a good $2 higher.
"All the large cargoes are programmed to Asia, so its only 25kt lots people are looking at," said one trader.
Diesel remained the focus of the day with an EN590 cargo trading early at May IPE +$11 cif for May 1-10 dates and later at May IPE +$12.50 basis Le Havre for balance of April.
The higher prices reflected the tight prompt supply situation. A Russian 0.05 8,000 tonne parcel was heard traded at May IPE +$9 cif Hamburg.
FOD and DIN were holding around the May IPE +$4.50. A dual FOD/DIN cargo was sold at June IPE +$4 cif Le Havre for 10-20 May.
